cc:Work.dc:title: 157 large ships reach Jacksonville, 31 km from the entrance: 40% of the 393 seen at the entrance
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the St. Johns River route cells shaded by distinct large ships, and a step chart of ships against distance from the entrance; 393 ships at the entrance and 157 at Jacksonville.
